The '''''Majestic''''' was a small [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] used by [[Galaxy Tours/Legends|Galaxy Tours]]. [[Celia Durasha]] once served aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], and helped to return it to [[Spaceport/Legends|port]] after it was damaged by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].
